items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: I said, Ray, I got a parade, I got a funeral for you... He said, man, I like to play your job. You pay good.

ctx.x: Every time me and him would talk, he said, what's the matter, kid, you don't get no more parade? He said, man, I like to play your job. You pay good. I like to get more money than what they get. And, and, and, and, well, they just begin to get a little bit more money now. But I used to get more money than they get. I'd be just getting three dollars, two dollars, something like that. I don't know what they was getting. I used to get more than that for them all the time, you know what I mean? And sometimes I ring…
Because that one fella helped, but he wasn't really your real manager.
